import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 15;
    static final int M = 100005;
    static final int INF = (int) 1e9;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};

    static char[][] c = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] S = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] id = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] vis = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] Dis = new int[N][N];
    static int[] que = new int[M];
    static int[] fox = new int[N * N * 2];
    static int[] dist = new int[N * N * 2];
    static int[] flow = new int[M];
    static int[] to = new int[M];
    static int[] prevEdge = new int[M];
    static int k1 = 1;

    static class Node {
        int x, y;
        Node(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }

    static Node[] Q = new Node[100005];

    static void add(int p1, int p2, int p3) {
        to[++k1] = p2;
        flow[k1] = p3;
        prevEdge[k1] = fox[p1];
        fox[p1] = k1;

        to[++k1] = p1;
        flow[k1] = 0;
        prevEdge[k1] = fox[p2];
        fox[p2] = k1;
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        int l = 1, r = 1;
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[st] = 0;
        que[1] = st;

        while (l <= r) {
            int p = que[l++];
            for (int i = fox[p]; i != 0; i = prevEdge[i]) {
                if (flow[i] > 0 && dist[to[i]] == -1) {
                    dist[to[i]] = dist[p] + 1;
                    que[++r] = to[i];
                }
            }
        }

        return dist[ed] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int num, int flowAmount) {
        if (num == ed) return flowAmount;
        int nowans = 0;
        for (int i = fox[num]; i != 0 && flowAmount > 0; i = prevEdge[i]) {
            if (flow[i] > 0 && dist[to[i]] == dist[num] + 1) {
                int a = dfs(to[i], Math.min(flow[i], flowAmount));
                if (a > 0) {
                    flow[i] -= a;
                    flow[i ^ 1] += a;
                    flowAmount -= a;
                    nowans += a;
                }
            }
        }
        if (nowans == 0) dist[num] = INF;
        return nowans;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            int j = dfs(st, INF);
            while (j > 0) {
                ans += j;
                j = dfs(st, INF);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int x, int y, int n) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && vis[x][y] == 0 && c[x][y] >= '0' && c[x][y] <= '9';
    }

    static void Bfs(int sx, int sy, int n) {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(dis[i], 60);
        dis[sx][sy] = 0;
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        Q[++r] = new Node(sx, sy);

        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = Q[l].x, ay = Q[l].y;
            l++;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny, n)) {
                    dis[nx][ny] = dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Find(int tx, int ty, int idx, int t, int n) {
        int l = 1, r = 0;
        Q[++r] = new Node(tx, ty);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(Dis[i], 60);
        vis[tx][ty] = 1;
        Dis[tx][ty] = 0;

        while (l <= r) {
            int ax = Q[l].x, ay = Q[l].y;
            l++;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = ax + dx[i], ny = ay + dy[i];
                if (check(nx, ny, n)) {
                    Dis[nx][ny] = Dis[ax][ay] + 1;
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                    if (Dis[nx][ny] < dis[nx][ny]) {
                        Q[++r] = new Node(nx, ny);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Dis[i][j] <= t && S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9' && Dis[i][j] <= dis[i][j]) {
                    add(idx, id[i][j] + tot, INF);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int st, ed, tot;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            c[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            S[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }

        int sx = -1, sy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (sx != -1) break;
        }

        tot = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++tot;
            }
        }

        st = 2 * tot + 1;
        ed = st + 1;

        Bfs(sx, sy, n);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (c[i][j] > '0' && c[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(st, id[i][j], c[i][j] - '0');
                    Find(i, j, id[i][j], t, n);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (S[i][j] > '0' && S[i][j] <= '9') {
                    add(id[i][j] + tot, ed, S[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxflow());
    }
}
